# Cargo One

> Cargo One is a UK logistics marketplace that connects customers with verified drivers to move almost anything, from a single parcel to a car, a pallet or a house move. Customers get an instant price, book online, follow their driver on a live map and receive photo proof of delivery.

Website: https://cargoone.co.uk
Area served: United Kingdom
Availability: open 24/7, 365 days a year

## How it works
- Enter pickup, drop-off and what you're moving to get an instant price.
- A verified driver accepts the job, and you can see who's coming.
- Track the driver live on the map and receive photo proof of delivery.

## Ways to book
- ASAP: the job is offered straight away to nearby drivers who are online. Used for urgent jobs, including 24/7 vehicle recovery.
- Scheduled: choose a date and time. Jobs can be posted for driver bids or at a fixed price.

## ASAP live dispatch and ASAP Recovery
- ASAP is Cargo One's on-demand, app-based live dispatch. There are two ASAP booking types: ASAP Transport (moving items now) and ASAP Recovery (moving vehicles now, such as breakdowns, non-runners and accident-damaged vehicles).
- Book 24/7, 365 days a year, with drivers available around the clock. There are no guaranteed arrival or response times.
- The customer enters pickup, drop-off and what's being moved (for recovery: vehicle location, destination, whether it runs, whether there are keys and whether the wheels turn), chooses a vehicle and sees an instant price.
- Pay Cargo One's booking fee by card. The driver's price is paid to the driver on delivery.
- Available drivers near the pickup with a suitable vehicle are alerted first; the search widens if needed; the first suitable driver to accept is assigned.
- Live tracking on the map from acceptance, through collection, to drop-off. The driver uploads photo proof when the job is done and the customer gets a notification.
- While still waiting for a driver, the customer can cancel in the app and the booking fee is refunded in full. After collection, the job can't be cancelled in the app; contact support.
- Motorway safety: vehicles on a live motorway should first be moved by the official services; then book recovery from a safe place.
- Other booking types: Bid Jobs (drivers send offers for a scheduled job) and Fixed Price Jobs (the customer sets the price up front).
- [ASAP live dispatch explained](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap)
- [How live tracking works](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/live-tracking)
- [24/7 ASAP vehicle recovery](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery)
- ASAP Recovery by city: [London](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/london), [Birmingham](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/birmingham), [Manchester](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/manchester), [Leeds](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/leeds), [Glasgow](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/glasgow), [Liverpool](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/liverpool), [Newcastle](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/newcastle), [Sheffield](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/sheffield), [Bristol](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/bristol), [Nottingham](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/nottingham), [Stoke-on-Trent](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/stoke-on-trent), [Preston](https://cargoone.co.uk/asap/recovery/preston)

## Jobs for drivers
- [Find courier, man and van & recovery jobs](https://cargoone.co.uk/find-jobs): anonymised recent jobs (item type and towns only). Bid Jobs and Fixed Price Jobs are free for drivers; bidding happens in the CargoOne Driver app.
